text: The Corporations Nominating Panel must select candidates for interviews for appointment to the Toronto Hydro Board. Following the interviews, the Corporations Nominating Panel will recommend eight candidates for appointment to City Council.

The Corporations Nominating Panel: 1. Selected the following candidates for interview for appointment to the Toronto Hydro Board: - THY1-158 - THY1-282 - THY2-37 - THY2-46 - THY2-47 - THY2-48 - THY2-51 - THY2-53 - THY2-63 - THY2-67 - THY2-90 - THY2-92 - THY2-97 - THY2-112 - THY2-149 2. Directed that Confidential Attachments 1, 2 and 3 to the report (January 6, 2020) remain confidential in their entirety as they relate to personal matters about identifiable individuals being considered for appointment to the Toronto Hydro Board.
